text:
maria_support: Hi Janet — sorry you hit this. Can you paste the tenant id, sample request_id, and approximate time window? I'll pull logs and loop in eng/security.
janet_customer: Tenant = acme-123, request_id=req_0a1b2c3d, seen errors starting ~2026-03-14T22:30Z. We have lots of 504s on /v1/chat and our SCIM audit shows gaps for that timeframe. App logs show 'decryption failed: HSM_UNAVAILABLE'. Compliance team is blocked.
jamal_engineer: Thanks. Pulling KMS logs now. I can already see a spike of KMS_DECRYPT_ERR for tenant acme-123 around 22:31-22:36 UTC.
leo_sre: Heads up: we ran a firmware update on HSM cluster nodes starting 2026-03-14T22:15Z; it was supposed to be non-disruptive but I see connection resets to HSMs at ~22:33. Investigating root cause.
sarah_security: If audit entries are missing we need to know whether events were generated and failed to export, or never emitted. This affects retention/legal response — tag as compliance-impacting.
maria_support: Quick unblock question: can the SCIM service account secrets still be decrypted? If not we may need a resync flow that uses ephemeral creds or a fallback to re-emit events without using persisted KMS secrets.
jamal_engineer: Right now stored provisioner secrets hit KMS on resync. Short-term mitigation: start resync with ephemeral token generation (fallback path) to re-emit SCIM events, then reconcile identities. Not ideal for long-term audit integrity but will recreate audit rows.
leo_sre: I'm seeing AUTH_EXPIRED then ERR_CONN_RESET from HSM nodes 3 and 4 between 22:32-22:39. I'll initiate a rollback of the firmware patch to restore steady state. Will coordinate timing for any resync to avoid race.
sarah_security: Also want to note least-privilege gap: the SCIM export SA currently has org-admin scope. We should carve out a dedicated scim-exporter role with minimal permissions as part of the postmortem.
maria_support: Janet — proposed plan: 1) SRE rollback HSM firmware, 2) resync SCIM for acme-123 under supervision using fallback tokens, 3) replay missing events to audit-store and provide signed CSV export, 4) security review for SA perms. ETA 30-90m.
deploy-bot: deploy: rolling back hsm-firmware v4.3.1 -> v4.2.9 initiated by leo_sre
janet_customer: Will that give us the missing audit export? Compliance needs the entries EOD.
sarah_security: After replay completes we'll produce a signed CSV and short attestation for the customer. Target within 2 hours of replay completion.
jamal_engineer: Adding a quick repro snippet to capture the failure behavior for on-call handoff:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/Users -d '{"userName":"test+scim@acme.com"}' -v
# during failure window returned 502/504 with body containing "kms: decrypt failed"
```
maria_support: Escalating to P2 -> eng-sre + security. Ticket INC-2026-045 created and linked to customer case.
leo_sre: Rollback complete, HSM cluster healthchecks OK, KMS decrypt latency back to baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollback complete. healthcheck: OK
jamal_engineer: Triggered resync for tenant acme-123; found ~120 missing SCIM events. Replay job queued to audit-store; will verify integrity and timestamps before export.
maria_support: Notifying customer and sharing ETA for CSV.
janet_customer: We received the CSV + attestation, audit team confirms completeness. Thanks for moving fast :heart:
sarah_security: Follow-ups logged: SEC-2026-110 — create scim-exporter least-priv role, add HSM canary to release preflight, add per-tenant KMS decrypt-rate alerting.
jamal_engineer: I'll open PRs: add retries/backoff to kms-proxy auth, and clearer customer-facing error strings ('temporary decryption error, retry in 5s').
maria_support: Closing loop with Janet. If anything else crops up reopen INC-2026-045.
janet_customer: Appreciate the quick response and the signed export — closing from our side.
